item.title: Mac Resource Monitor 1.3.0
item.description:
• The Local AI Models panel now monitors three local inference servers instead of one: LM Studio, oMLX and Ollama.
  • oMLX needs no setup — its host, port and API key are picked up from oMLX's own settings. Shows loaded models, model memory against the ceiling, generation and prefill tokens/sec, queue depth and cache hit rate.
  • Ollama shows resident models with size, parameter count and quantization, the keep-alive countdown, and flags any model that is only partly on the GPU.
  • The menu bar popover now lists whichever inference backends are actually running, with their loaded model counts.
